# Push the table, and you roll back

<!-- STEP id="kick" -->
When you kick a ball, your foot pushes the ball. You also feel the ball push on your foot. A force always needs two objects, and each one pushes on the other.

<!-- STEP id="chair" -->
Sit on a chair with wheels and lift your feet off the floor. Push a heavy table away from you: your chair rolls backwards. Pull the table towards you: your chair rolls towards it.

Each time, the table exerts a force on you in the opposite direction.
